one_liner: Senior deputy managing acquisition strategy, contracting, and budget execution for the Navy's Conventional Prompt Strike hypersonic missile program office.
fit_summary: This role needs a year at GS-13 level applying DoD 5000-series acquisition, analyzing cost and schedule data, and coordinating contracting and budget execution, plus SCI. Daniel's contractor-side proposal and purchasing work doesn't reach that, so skip it.
eligibility: Open to the public, so no federal status is needed, but this is a flyer for anticipated vacancies, and applications are not accepted through the flyer itself.

You need one year of specialized experience equivalent to NH-03/GS-13 using Navy/DoD acquisition-management principles (including DoD 5000-series), analyzing cost, schedule, technical, contract, and financial data, or coordinating acquisition, contracting, and budget execution.
The position requires Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) access, which means passing a Top Secret/SCI background investigation.
Your resume must be no more than 2 pages, and all qualifications must be met before you can be considered.
strategy: Skip it; his IEM work doesn't include program-level acquisition management.
A better path is GS-9 to GS-12 emergency management specialist or program analyst roles, including at FEMA, or legislative affairs jobs that use his interest in policy.
resume_bullets: Found federal opportunities in SAM.gov, GovWin and the DHS acquisition forecast, and led proposal writing (2019–2024).
